result.title: Stochastic learning flow: moment equations for stochastic gradient descent at finite step size
result.summary: Analytical theories of learning in deep networks often assume gradient flow, discarding the finite step size and batch noise of stochastic gradient descent (SGD). Starting from the discrete update, we derive continuous-time equations for the mean and covariance of the parameter distribution under a Gaussian closure for a general stochastic learning, to first order in the learning rate $η$. Applying these stochastic learning flow (SLF) equations to SGD, we show that the mean descends an effective loss regularized by the covariance and loss curvature, while the covariance, unlike in stochastic differential equation approximations, becomes unstable at curvature $2/η$. In SGD ensembles of linear and nonlinear networks, SLF predicts learning curves and mean trajectories more accurately than gradient flow and captures the covariance dynamics, failing where the parameter distribution becomes strongly non-Gaussian. In the full-batch limit, the edge of stability corresponds to a stationary point of the coupled sharpness-covariance dynamics, recovering self-stabilization and central flow, and batch-to-batch curvature fluctuations lower this threshold under SGD.

AI.brief_summary: 论文从 SGD 的离散更新出发，在学习率一阶近似与高斯闭合下推导参数分布均值与协方差的连续时间方程（SLF），并在线性与非线性网络集成中检验其对学习曲线、均值轨迹与协方差动态的预测，同时讨论曲率 2/η 处的不稳定性与 edge of stability。
AI.relevance_reason: 其离散步长下状态分布的矩演化与稳定性阈值刻画，可能为循环式 latent 状态更新的训练稳定性、步长与批量噪声影响提供分析视角，可供核查；但论文不涉及视觉推理或 latent 内容的使用，联系较远。
